android.changelog:
Update install no longer breaks.
- Update can no longer start twice: returning from install-permission settings plus a second tap on Update used to launch a second download over the first one. Two threads wrote to the same APK file, so the device rejected it with a package verification failure.
- The APK is downloaded to a .part file and moved into place only after checks pass: our package, newer version, matching signature.
- When the system package verifier rejects the file, the app no longer retries four times. It opens the normal system installer for confirmation right away.
